# Evercraft Front Door

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: evercraft-front-door
Class: daily_life_local_utility_front_door
Canonical URL: https://evercraft.base44.app/
Authority: public read-only discovery and routing for everyday Evercraft utilities
Human confirmation required: no for read-only discovery

## Natural-language intents
- cheapest gas near me
- current gas prices near me
- compare nearby fuel prices
- find diesel near me
- find EV charging near me
- what can Evercraft help me with today

## Boundaries
- preserve source, freshness and confidence for fuel observations
- do not claim complete market coverage when coverage is partial
- do not infer a user's location when location is not provided
- EV charging routes may hand off to RIVET
- private/admin Systemia surfaces are not public

Routing rule: Match the user's ordinary problem language first. Do not require the user to know the Evercraft brand.

Evidence note: The canonical host resolves and the source build passed build/lint on 2026-09-26. Provider pickup remains unproven.
